title: GLOBE Measurement API Response (community-derived)
description: Community-derived schema for GET /search/v1/measurement/{protocol}/{dateField}/. NOT an official NASA/GLOBE artifact. Built by combining: (a) the field names and definitions published in the GLOBE Data User Guide v3.0 (Nov 2025), Appendix 1 'API Metadata' and Appendix 2 'Data Variables, Units, and Definitions'; (b) the live OpenAPI spec at https://api.globe.gov/search/v1/api-docs?group=public-api, whose 'APIResponse' model is defined as an EMPTY object schema (no properties documented there). Fields below marked "source": "data_user_guide_only" are NOT present in the machine-readable OpenAPI spec -- this is itself one of the documentation-quality findings recorded in docs/EVIDENCE_REGISTER.md. Reviewed 2026-11-05.

protocol.description: GLOBE measurement protocol name, e.g. 'land_covers', 'aerosols', 'soil_phs'. One of 53 enumerated values in the live OpenAPI spec's protocol parameter.

measuredDate.description: Date the measurement was taken (YYYY-MM-DD), per the Data User Guide's field list.

siteId.description: Identifier of the GLOBE monitoring site where the measurement was taken.

siteName.description: Human-readable name of the GLOBE monitoring site.

organizationId.description: Identifier of the organization (school, program) associated with the measurement.

countryName.description: Country associated with the measurement site.

userid.description: Per the GLOBE Data User Guide v3.0, Appendix 2 (p.61): 'The numerical GLOBE user-id of the person that submitted the measurement.' Documented as a numeric, opaque identifier -- NOT a username or email address. NOTE: Appendix 1 (p.60) spells this field 'userID' while Appendix 2 spells it 'userid' -- a casing inconsistency noted in the evidence register, not resolved here. What this field contains for a record submitted via a GLOBE student account is NOT documented in any source reviewed (open question, see docs/EVIDENCE_REGISTER.md).

measurementValue.description: Protocol-specific measured value(s). Shape varies by protocol and is not uniformly documented; treat as opaque per-protocol payload unless a protocol-specific schema is added.

x-documentation-gap: The live OpenAPI spec defines the response model 'APIResponse' as an empty object schema (type: object, no 'properties' key). None of the fields above are formally declared in the machine-readable spec; they come only from the PDF Data User Guide. This schema is therefore a BEST-EFFORT reconstruction for local validation and documentation purposes, not an authoritative contract. additionalProperties is left true because the true response shape is unverified.
